subject: Calypso pilot: MAP, dataset exchange clearance & closing timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Mullins <sarah.mullins@calypso.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.rivera@calypso.com
Date: 2026-04-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot dataset exchange + draft MAP

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Calypso's ML team is ready to run a short pilot. We have a small evaluation corpus and a prompt pack that we'd like to share under a mutual action plan so both sides have a clear close timeline and usage constraints. High-level asks from our side: 

- Short-term sandbox access (ephemeral, not allowed for production).
- 90-day access window for the evaluation artifacts with a guaranteed takedown after acceptance.
- No redistribution, no embedding model training without express permission.

I've attached the evaluation bundle (calypso_eval_pack_v1.zip) and a quick README that explains the file structure. Can Redwood circulate a MAP + draft terms (retention, audit log needs, RSA/KMS notes) and suggest a handoff/takedown timeline?

Target kickoff: week of May 4 if that works.

Best,
Sarah Mullins
Director, Applied ML
Calypso Retail

Attachments: calypso_eval_pack_v1.zip, prompt-pack-README.md

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Mullins <sarah.mullins@calypso.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot dataset exchange + draft MAP

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending the bundle and the README. We're excited to run this pilot with Calypso. I've attached an initial MAP that covers: scope, roles, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and a proposed 4-week close timeline. Key points in the draft (RDW-MAP-draft-4721.pdf):

- Access window: 60 days by default; we can extend to 90 days on request (we'll record extension requests in the MAP).
- Retention: evaluation artifacts stored in an ephemeral sandbox; persistent logs retained 30 days unless audit exemption applies.
- Usage: non-production only; no model training or embedding retention outside the sandbox; derivative-work restrictions enumerated.
- Audit: we will provide request-level logs and token usage reports; KMS integration details in appendix.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue May 4: kickoff & credentials exchange
- Wed May 5–Mon May 24: evaluation window (3 weeks active testing + 1 week buffer)
- Tue May 25: acceptance review
- Wed May 26: takedown / revocation (unless both parties sign an extension)

Laura and Karthik, looping you in for compliance/legal redlines. Sarah — can you confirm Calypso's legal contact for the quick NDA check (we received a signed version but we may need a short addendum for audit logs)? Also confirm whether 60 or 90 days is preferred.

I'll add a DocuSign envelope for the MAP + short addendum once we agree items.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: RDW-MAP-draft-4721.pdf

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-22T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot dataset exchange + draft MAP — internal redlines

Laura / Karthik — sharing a quick internal note with suggested redlines before we send the DocuSign: 

1) Retention compromise: propose default logs retained 30 days, but exportable audit bundle retained up to 180 days for compliance review if Calypso signs the addendum. Export requires an explicit request and will be delivered via secure transfer.
2) Ephemeral sandbox: ensure KV/prefix caching is disabled for these assets; any in-memory caches cleared on session end.
3) No embeddings/training: add technical enforcement clause — disable embedding endpoints for the project key and strip any model-see tokens from logs.
4) Derivative clause: allow synthetic outputs for non-commercial evaluation, prohibit model re-training or redistribution.
5) Security evidence: attach snapshot of SOC2 cert and provide log retention SLA in appendix.

If you agree I'll incorporate these into RDW-MAP-draft-4721.pdf and issue the DocuSign. Also confirm whether treasury should approve the 90-day extension charge (if Calypso wants 90 instead of 60).

-M

From: Calypso Legal <legal@calypso.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, Sarah Mullins <sarah.mullins@calypso.com>
Date: 2026-04-27T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot dataset exchange + draft MAP — legal redlines

Markus / Sarah — quick legal redlines from our side: 

1) Retention: Calypso needs audit logs available for 6 months for internal review. We understand operational concerns; acceptable compromise if logs are stored encrypted and access is auditable (read-only unless an export is requested).
2) Derivative works: add explicit carve-out to allow our internal benchmarks on Redwood outputs, but still prohibit downstream model training on raw evaluation artifacts.
3) Liability: reduce Redwood's liability cap for data loss to align with pilot scope.

We can sign the MAP once the 6-month audit log clause is handled. Tom Rivera will own the signature for procurement.

Best,
Calypso Legal (on behalf of Sarah Mullins)

--
Tom Rivera
Procurement Manager, Calypso Retail
Attachments referenced: Calypso_NDA_signed.pdf

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Mullins <sarah.mullins@calypso.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@calypso.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot dataset exchange + draft MAP — agreement and next steps

Thanks Tom / Sarah — we reviewed Legal's requests and can accept the compromise with the following implementation notes: 

- Audit log retention: we will hold encrypted, auditable request logs for 180 days (6 months) in a locked export bundle. Access requires an internal request and will be recorded in the MAP. Logs are read-only unless Calypso requests an export.
- Retention/ephemeral sandbox: evaluation artifacts remain in the sandbox; any extension requests beyond the baseline window are formalized in the MAP and require procurement approval.
- Derivative use: we added the carve-out for internal benchmark use of Redwood outputs; explicit prohibition on training models on raw evaluation artifacts is retained.
- Liability language: updated for pilot scope; see appended final MAP in DocuSign.

Next steps:
1) I've updated RDW-MAP-draft-4721.pdf with the changes and uploaded the final package to DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/containers/ABC123-example
2) Once Calypso signs, we will provision ephemeral credentials and toggle the project key (no embeddings allowed).
3) Kickoff call scheduled: Tue May 4, 09:00 PT — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Looking forward to getting the pilot live.

Markus Klein
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
Attachments: RDW-MAP-draft-4721.pdf, prompt-pack-README.md
